landing.text:
HEADLINE
Turn client feedback into actionable project tasks without overwhelming clients

SUBHEADLINE
For dev agency project managers, clients' ad-hoc feedback is lost in Slack, email, and Loom, causing misunderstandings and delayed projects.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps dev agency project managers move from clients' ad-hoc feedback is lost in slack, email,  to turn client feedback into actionable project tasks.

WHO IT IS FOR
Dev agency project managers

THE PROBLEM
Clients' ad-hoc feedback is lost in Slack, email, and Loom, causing misunderstandings and delayed projects

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets or manual note-taking was not designed for dev agency project managers. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing dev agency project managers to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Automates task ticket creation from client feedback across multiple channels.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of Slack-based client feedback ag reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with Slack-based client feedback aggregator with task ticketing.
